Pair manually

  1. Open Hexbot and choose "Connect to a daemon".
  2. Enter the host and port shown above.
  3. Enter the pairing code. Codes expire after ten minutes and work once.

The code stays after the # in this page's address. Browsers do not send that part to this site.
